purpose: Record one fail-closed adapter repair after all Campaign009 partitions were computed but before a final snapshot, comparison value, daily price, or forward return existed.

root_cause.description: The inherited Campaign006 executor constructs an in-memory pre-publication manifest with its native source_open_high_low_read=false and source_volume_read=true flags. The Campaign009 publication adapter changes those two flags to true/false only inside the atomic writer. The Campaign009 validator incorrectly required the post-publication flags even during the earlier pre-publication validation, so it rejected the valid in-memory manifest before the adapter could write it.

single_permitted_repair.description: Make the validator phase-aware: require the inherited false/true open-high-low/volume flags when require_fingerprint_constants=false, and require the Campaign009 true/false flags when require_fingerprint_constants=true. Keep the atomic publication conversion and every factor, field whitelist, OHLC ordering rule, 120-bar threshold, range, gate, comparison, and trial unchanged.
